summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's assumption, I could **not** find an obvious client-side wiring bug in the current code: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — it always loads/saves via `api.get/post/delete("/watchlist...")`. - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"`
